name: Fire Hand
benefit:
You can wield a torch as a weapon without taking the nonproficient penalty and gain a +1 bonus on attack rolls with melee weapons that deal fire damage.
## Combat Trick (from the Combat Stamina feat)
**Source** Pathfinder Unchained pg. 119
When you hit with a torch attack, you can spend 1 stamina point. If you do, the fire damage dealt with that attack increases to 1d6 points of fire damage.
flavor: Born with a torch in your hand, you have a gift with anything that burns.
